tool_input.command: cd /work; for p in "16 22" "17 23" "18 21" "16 21"; do set -- $p; sed "s/17 - t/$1 - t/;s/t - 21/t - $2/" champion.py > model.py; echo $p; python practice.py champion.py model.py | tail -3; done

cd /work; for p in "16 22" "17 23" "18 21" "16 21"; do a=${p% *}; b=${p#* }; sed "s/17 - t/$a - t/;s/t - 21/t - $b/" champion.py > model.py; echo $p; python practice.py champion.py model.py | tail -3; done

cd /work; cat > /tmp/s.py <<'E'
import subprocess,sys
src=open('champion.py').read()
for a,b in [(16,22),(17,23),(18,21),(16,21)]:
    open('model.py','w').write(src.replace('17 - t',f'{a} - t').replace('t - 21',f't - {b}'))
    print(a,b,subprocess.run(['python','practice.py','champion.py','model.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()[-200:])
E
python /tmp/s.py
cd /work; sed -i 's/t - 21/t - 23/' champion.py 2>/dev/null; cp champion.py /dev/null; git diff 2>/dev/null; grep -n maximum champion.py model.py

cd /work; for f in "16 - t,0), np.maximum(t - 22" "17 - t,0), np.maximum(t - 23" "16 - t,0), np.maximum(t - 23"; do python - "$f" <<'E'
import sys,subprocess
s=open('champion.py').read().replace("17 - t,0), np.maximum(t - 21",sys.argv[1])
open('model.py','w').write(s)
print(sys.argv[1],subprocess.run(['python','practice.py','champion.py','model.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout)
E
done

cd /work; rm scan_tmp.py; sed 's/17 - t, 0), np.maximum(t - 21/16 - t, 0), np.maximum(t - 22/;s/np.maximum(17 - t,0), np.maximum(t - 21,0)/np.maximum(16 - t, 0), np.maximum(t - 22, 0)/' champion.py > model.py; grep -n maximum model.py; python check.py | tail -2; python practice.py champion.py model.py
